sources.title: barryallen16/tamil-tokenizer: Rust BPE tokenizer for Tamil - GitHub
sources.snippet: A high-performance Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizer library for Tamil text, written in Rust. Designed for training and using custom tokenizers on Tamil corpora with an Aho-Corasick-based fast encoder.

sources.title: Your AI charges speakers of Tamil 10× more than English, and the fix is ...
sources.snippet: A developer in Chennai opens her laptop and prompts GPT-4 in Tamil. Three paragraphs. Maybe 150 words. The API bills her for 620 tokens. Her colleague in San Francisco writes the same message in English. 180 tokens. Same meaning. Same model. Same price per thousand tokens.
